Yaounde, Cameroon - Age 19

I left Cameroon at 15, having completed only Grade 10. The American school placed me directly in Grade 12 because they saw something in me I had not yet proven. I graduated Magna Cum Laude, GPA 3.583, studying in a foreign language, adapting to a new culture and an entirely different educational system. Their intuition was right.

Innovation

Featured Project

🏥
Digital Healthcare Infrastructure
Healthcare - Data Engineering - Cameroon - 2025
MbaoMed

A digital patient registration prototype targeting two critical failures in Cameroonian hospitals: catastrophic data loss from handwritten records, and unmanageable queue times.

Built during first semester at ICT University Yaounde. Proof of concept that lightweight data infrastructure can reduce systemic inefficiencies without requiring full hospital IT overhauls.

This is not a school exercise. It is the first step of a career built around one observation: Cameroon's clinics fail patients because of data problems, not just funding problems.
